test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Blankets are Bedsheets.

Some Bedsheets are Pillows.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Blankets are Pillows.

II. All Bedsheets can never be Pillows.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a15dfbc293cbb673af95c813df5c2aa3ded5fbc6c00655092061a2c32c009ecc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Blankets are Pillows → False (Some Blankets are Bedsheets and Some Bedsheets are Pillows so, Some Blankets are Pillows is false)

II. All Bedsheets can never be Pillows → False (Some Bedsheets are Pillows so, All Bedsheets can never be Pillows is not definite)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follow".**
